faq.q: What rules govern the acreage parcels on this page's feed?
faq.a: Parcel by parcel: if a parcel is in the Agricultural Land Reserve, the ALC frame applies — a principal residence capped at 500 m² with any suite inside it, at most one additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (>40 ha), and ALC permission required to subdivide outside limited exceptions; urban Surrey suite, coach-house and SSMUH rules apply only to non-ALR urban lots.

faq.q: Which schools serve the ground this feed shows?
faq.a: Schools confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file for this part of Surrey include Morgan Elementary (3366 156a St) and Earl Marriott Secondary (15751 16 Ave) — a feed card names both as catchments in its listing text, but SD36 catchments are address-based and no locator run for this ground is on record, so confirm any address before relying on a school (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).
